title: Fidelity-reservoir promoter with causal smoke-replay and automated rollforward
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Introduces a fidelity-reservoir promotion controller to enable causally-consistent smoke replays and automated rollforward; opt-in via rolloutPolicy: fidelityReservoir; no API changes to public generation endpoints.
description:
Motivation: production rollouts for models and model variants increasingly need two capabilities in one flow: (1) targeted A/B/cohort experiments that preserve causal session semantics across shadow->canary transitions, and (2) an automated, metric-driven rollforward/rollback path that can perform causal smoke replays of a recent traffic window to validate regressions before committing traffic. This PR implements a new promotion controller called the 'fidelity-reservoir promoter' that coordinates staged cohort promotions with causal smoke replays and a rollforward saga when regressions are transient or explainable.

Summary of changes: added a new rollout controller (controllers/fidelity_reservoir) that maintains a small reservoir of high-fidelity shadow requests (session keys + prefix trees + KV-cache snapshots). The controller can: 1) seed candidate cohorts from the reservoir; 2) perform causal smoke replays where the same sequence of requests is re-run against the canary+baseline in isolation (bounded window) and differences are captured as structured diffs; 3) compute a fidelity score (latency, token-level logprob drift, semantic divergence via eval embeddings) and compare to configurable gates; 4) drive automated rollforward when transient drift is observed and remediation heuristics (retry with warmed KV cache, quantization fallback) succeed.

Checklist: - [x] Controller implementation and unit tests - [x] E2E smoke harness that drives shadow capture -> replay -> decision flow - [x] Telemetry hooks (promoter.metrics.{promote,rollback,smoke_replay,drift_score}) - [x] New rolloutPolicy schema validation + examples in redwood/examples/rollouts - [x] Backwards-compatible: default rollout behavior unchanged unless rolloutPolicy.fidelityReservoir enabled

Commits: ["init: add fidelity reservoir controller scaffold", "feature: implement smoke replay runner and diffing", "perf: KV-cache snapshot/restore optimization", "tests: add unit + integration tests for promoter", "docs: rolloutPolicy examples and migration notes", "ci: add smoke replay job to canary integration pipeline"]

Files changed (high level): ["controllers/fidelity_reservoir/controller.go", "controllers/fidelity_reservoir/replay_runner.go", "controllers/fidelity_reservoir/metrics.go", "pkg/rollout/policy_schema.go", "pkg/kvcache/snapshot.go", "redwood-examples/rollouts/fidelity-reservoir.yaml", "docs/rollouts/fidelity-reservoir.md", "test/integration/fidelity_replay_test.go", "ci/pipelines/canary-smoke.yml"]

Design notes and constraints: - Reservoir sizing is intentionally modest by default (200 recent high-fidelity sessions) to avoid storage/compute blowup; policy config allows tuning. - Causal smoke replay replays within user-visible session windows to preserve ordering and KV-cache state; we snapshot and restore lightweight KV caches and prefix caches to avoid cross-talk. - The diffing pipeline computes three orthogonal signals: latency percentile delta, token-level logprob KL, and semantic drift via embedding cosine distance. These are combined into an interpretable fidelity_score with weightings configurable per rollout. - Rollforward path: if a regression is detected but the replay indicates a transient root cause (e.g., cold KV cache), the promoter attempts a sequence of remediations (KV warmup, fall back to a compatible quantized variant, or increase batch headroom) and re-runs the replay; a successful remediation path triggers an automated rollforward commit.

Testing and CI: CI added a new canary-smoke job which exercises a synthetic shadow producer that seeds the reservoir and triggers the replay flow. One flaky test (TestReplayTimingEdge) failed on the first run due to a race in the synthetic clock used in tests; fixed with a deterministic clock stub in the second commit. All pipeline checks now pass.

Review conversation (high level): - Diego Morales (2026-02-19): "Nice isolation of replay runner. Please add a short doc section on how to interpret fidelity_score in the UI — signal weighting will matter for product teams." Author: "Added docs/rollouts/fidelity-reservoir.md with examples and recommended defaults." - Evan Chen (2026-02-20): "Can we avoid snapshotting full KV store for large models? Concern on memory spikes." Author: "We only snapshot a warm working set (prefix entries + last-N tokens per session). Implemented conservative cap and streaming restore to keep peak memory stable." - Priya Kapoor (2026-02-22): "Telemetry looks good; add cardinality guard on sample tags (no unbounded session tag explosion)." Author: "Added sanitized sample tags and a metrics cardinality test to the suite." - Diego Morales (2026-02-23): "Would like a fallback policy example that uses quantized variant automatically." Author: "Added config example in redwood-examples/rollouts/fidelity-reservoir.yaml showing quantizeFallback: true and remediation chain ordering."

Manual validation steps executed by author prior to merge: 1) Deployed controller to staging with rolloutPolicy.fidelityReservoir enabled on a canary model; 2) Generated synthetic session traffic including prefix-heavy sequences and validated reservoir capture; 3) Triggered smoke replay and verified metrics emitted and diff report generated in logs; 4) Induced a KV-cache cold-start regression and confirmed remediation path (KV warmup -> replay -> rollforward) succeeded; 5) Ran canary integration suite (smoke + stability).

Backward compatibility notes: This is opt-in. No changes to public API for inference requests. rolloutPolicy JSON schema extended; older clients ignore the unfamiliar field.

Operational notes for SRE: - Promoter exposes /metrics and /debug/replay/{id} endpoints for on-demand artifact inspection. - Recommend enabling sample retention for reservoir artifacts in staging for 48h during initial rollout and setting up dashboard panels for promoter.metrics.fidelity_score and promoter.metrics.smoke_replay.duration. - Default remediation retries capped at 3 to avoid noisy flapping.

Follow-ups (future work): - Add automatic cohort selection heuristics based on model outcome variance (ENG-2209). - Integrate with Redwood Console rollout UI to visualize replay diffs and allow manual approve/abort on replay artifacts. - Expand remediation library with model-surgical interventions (e.g., selective quantization for embeddings).

Merge outcome: squashed and merged into main after reviewers approved and CI green.
